messages:
Alex: Customer reports applying two promo codes but the second one replaced the first; they lost ~$200 in credits. Need escalation and a manual restore.

Priya: Can you drop account id + the two codes here (or DM if PII)? Also need the billing snapshot timestamp.

Alex: Account acct_01FXXXX (masked). Codes: ABC100 (portal, created 2025-11-02) and XYZ100 (partner promo, applied via API). Billing snapshot before any action: credits: $100 (ABC100). After applying XYZ100 via API: credits: $100 (XYZ100) — ABC100 disappeared.

Alex: Quick repro I used: 1) Login to portal -> apply code ABC100 -> balance shows +100 credits. 2) Call API: `POST /v1/promos/apply` body `{ "account_id":"acct_01FXXXX", "code":"XYZ100" }` -> 200 OK. 3) Check balance -> shows only XYZ100. Expected: balances add (ABC + XYZ).

Sam: Do we have the API payload/response logs for that call? Curious if a flag like `replace_on_apply` is being sent.

Alex: Log snippet from our request logs (sanitized): `INFO applyPromo account=acct_01FXXXX code=XYZ100 response=200 body={"applied":true,"active_promo":"XYZ100"}`. No `stack=true` anywhere.

Maya: @Sam @Liu our docs for vouchers say stackable promos should increment balance unless explicitly marked `exclusive:true`. This looks like the apply path is defaulting to exclusive for API calls.

Liu: I dug into payments-service trace: `promo_service.apply(account, code, replace=True)` — the apply endpoint sets replace=True if the caller is the legacy promos controller. For portal flows it calls `apply(account, code, replace=False)`.

Priya: Customer is on enterprise plan (legacy org). They expect stacking. We need: 1) manual credit restore, 2) root cause fix, 3) postmortem + comms.

Sam: I can push a hotfix to change default to `replace=False` for the legacy endpoint, but we should gate it behind a feature flag and add a migration to reconcile accounts that lost credits.

Alex: Please proceed with manual restore first. Can someone create a one-off grant for $100 and annotate incident?

Priya: I'll create the grant and log the ticket. Also creating a billing escalation: TICKET-4321.

DeployBot: Incident created INC-2026-042 linked to TICKET-4321 by Alex :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll open a PR for the flag + tests. Needs review from @Liu and then we can canary to staging. Short repro test: apply ABC then API apply XYZ and assert balance == sum.

Maya: Also add an e2e in billing-integration tests and update the promos doc to clarify default behavior for legacy orgs.

Alex: Thanks all. Priya — ping me when grant is issued so I can confirm with the customer. Sam/Liu — please keep this thread updated with PR/rollback plan. :eyes:
